sloka: स वीरशयने शिश्ये विज्यमादाय कार्मुकम् ।भिन्नमुष्टिपरीणाहं त्रिनतं रत्नभूषितम् ।। ६.४५.२४ ।।।।
transliteration: sa vīraśayane śiśye vijyamādāya kārmukam ।bhinnamuṣṭiparīṇāhaṁ trinataṁ ratnabhūṣitam ।। 6.45.24 ।।।।

translations.english: Rama lay relaxed on the hero's bed quitting his goldplated bow strung and bent at both ends, and the middle.
